note: Hand-checked on 2026-10-16 against the cited files in the pack's documents folder (10-Q, Q2 earnings release, merger 8-K and press release, TRACE exports, indentures, credit agreement amendment, MGM and PENN releases). Quick depth of FULL_CREDIT_ASSESSMENT, scored with an R5 bar of filled >= 0.90 of the supportable cells below. Conventions are those of czr-2026q2-primary.json: USD millions, plain decimals, CP-1 metric ids, period ids H1_<yyyy> (six months to June 30; June 30 balances sit on H1_<yyyy>), total_debt the book value. Left out because the documents do not support them: (1) snapshot.transaction_summary: the merger 8-K and press release state committed debt financing from 10 banks but give no tranche, size, price talk or maturity, so no new tranche exists (the primary pack has a term sheet; this one has none). (2) snapshot.relative_value: no Sector RV Workbook or Bloomberg export; the two TRACE records state a last-trade yield but no spread, and CP-3 leaves such a row out and names it under Gaps. (3) snapshot.portfolio_fit and cp6.portfolio_recommendation: no portfolio file, so FIT is skipped. (4) snapshot.ebitda_adjustments has no unrealized add-back (no synergy figure is stated). (5) Projection and CP-1D items: neither runs at quick. (6) Fiscal-year history: no 10-K. Only the tables a quick module owns carry expected_rows (the scorecard denominator); host tables (RUN_BRIEF, MODEL) are listed as supportable but reported as not measured. Where the documents fix no count, the contract minimum is used and says so; expected_identities are set only for the three Strategy rows.
